אחת השאלות הנפוצות ביותר שאנחנו שומעים מ: One of the most common questions we hear from landlords is: "How much tax do I have to pay on my rent?" The answer depends on the tax option you choose, and it's usually worth running the numbers before you decide.
תקרת הפטור לשנת 2024 עמדה על 5,471 ₪ לחו: The exemption ceiling for 2024 was ₪5,471 per month. For 2025–2026 it was updated to ₪5,654 per month. The amount is updated each year in line with the index, so it's important to check with the Israel Tax Authority at the start of every year.
לפי סעיף 122(ב) לפקודת מס הכנסה, אם שכר: Under Section 122(b) of the Income Tax Ordinance, if your monthly rent does not exceed ₪5,654 (2025), you are completely exempt from tax. No reporting, no deductions, no complications.
חשוב: הפטור חל על סך כל ההכנסות משכר דיר: Important: the exemption applies to the total residential rental income of the whole family (including your spouse and children under 18), not to each property separately. If two apartments bring in ₪5,000 together, you're exempt. If they bring in ₪11,000, you're not.
כשההכנסה גבוהה מ-5,654 ₪ אך נמוכה מ-11,3: When income is above ₪5,654 but below ₪11,308 (double the ceiling), a declining partial exemption applies: for every shekel above the ceiling, the exemption shrinks by one shekel, until it disappears entirely at an income of ₪11,308.
השכרה לטווח קצר (Airbnb, דירת נופש) אינה: Short-term rentals (Airbnb, holiday apartments) are not considered "residential rent" and do not benefit from the exemption. See our separate article on Airbnb taxation.
לפי סעיף 122(א) לפקודה, ניתן לשלם 10% מס: Under Section 122(a) of the Ordinance, you can pay a flat 10% tax on all rental income, whatever the amount. Under this option you cannot deduct running expenses, but you can deduct annual depreciation of 2% of the building's purchase cost (excluding the land).
כשהשכר גבוה (מעל 7,000 ₪ לחודש) ואין לכם: When the rent is high (over ₪7,000 per month) and you don't have large expenses on the property. The 2% annual deduction can be significant for expensive properties. Since 2025, a full lease must be attached when reporting under this option.
במסלול זה, שכר הדירה מצטרף להכנסות הרגיל: Under this option, your rent is added to your regular income and taxed at your marginal rate (10% to 47%, plus an additional 3% tax for high earners). This option lets you deduct direct expenses: depreciation (2% of the building's cost), mortgage interest, repairs, insurance, any arnona (municipal tax) you pay, management fees and more.
המסלול משתלם כשיש לכם הוצאות גדולות על ה: This option pays off when you have large expenses on the property, especially a high mortgage, or when your regular income is low.
הבחירה במסלול מס היא סופית לאותה שנת מס: Your choice of tax option is final for that tax year and cannot be changed retroactively. Failing to report rental income may be considered a criminal offense. Planning ahead will save you thousands of shekels.
ב-17 בספטמבר 2017 נכנס לתוקף תיקון מספר: On September 17, 2017, Amendment No. 1 to the Rental and Loan Law, 5731-1971, known as the "Fair Rental Law" (5777-2017), came into force. The amendment added 15 new sections (25A–25I), creating a binding framework of protection for residential tenants. Any provision in a lease that contradicts the law is void.
חובת מסירת דירה ראויה למגורים: The duty to provide an apartment fit for living in
על בעל הדירה למסור נכס הראוי למגורים, כו: The landlord must hand over a property that is fit for living in, including working essential systems: electricity, plumbing, gas, a safe structure, and heating or cooling systems if these were agreed in the lease.
אחריות לתיקון ליקויים — שני סוגים ושני ל: Responsibility for repairing defects: two types and two timelines
שריפה, נזילת גז, קצר חשמל, ביוב מגעיל: Fire, gas leak, electrical short circuit, foul sewage
נזילה חמורה, מערכת חימום שבורה, עובש נרח: Serious leak, broken heating system, widespread mold
ברז מטפטף, צבע מתקלף, תריס קטן: Dripping tap, peeling paint, small shutter
אם בעל הדירה לא תיקן ליקוי מהותי תוך המו: If the landlord does not repair a material defect within the set time, the tenant may carry out the repair and deduct the cost from the rent, with prior written notice. A lease cannot make the tenant responsible for repairing material defects.
ערבות ופיקדון — מה מותר לדרוש?: Guarantees and deposits: what can you ask for?
החוק קובע: הסכום המרבי שניתן לדרוש כערבו: The law states that the maximum amount you can require as security is the lower of two figures: three months' rent, or one third of the total rent for the entire lease term. The deposit must be returned within 60 days of the end of the tenancy, provided that the tenant has met all of their obligations.
ביטוח מבנה — לא ניתן לגלגל על השוכר: Building insurance: it can't be passed on to the tenant
סעיף 25ט קובע מפורשות: הוצאות ביטוח המבנ: Section 25I states explicitly that building insurance costs are borne by the property owner alone. Any lease clause requiring the tenant to pay for building insurance is void.
מה אסור לכלול בחוזה?: What can't be included in a lease?

כל חוזה שכירות שאנחנו מנסחים ב-S&M מותאם: Every lease we draft at S&M fully complies with the Fair Rental Law. A flawed lease can lead to void clauses, partial protection and enforcement difficulties.
אחד השלבים הקריטיים ביותר בניהול נכס הוא: Choosing the tenant is one of the most critical stages of managing a property. A mistake here is expensive: unpaid rent, damage to the property, legal proceedings and months of vacancy. This is the method we use.
לפני שמזמינים לפגישה, שאלו: מאיפה הם, כמ: Before inviting anyone to a viewing, ask where they're from, how many people will live there, whether they have pets and when they'd like to move in. Five minutes on the phone will filter out most people who wouldn't be suitable anyway.

בקשו 3 תלושי שכר אחרונים או תיעוד הכנסה: Ask for the last 3 pay slips or equivalent proof of income. A common rule of thumb is a monthly income of at least 3 times the rent. For self-employed applicants, ask for their latest tax assessment.
ניתן לבקש מהמועמד דוח בדיקת אשראי (שניתן: You can ask the applicant for a credit check report (available free once a year from BDI and other companies). Look for open enforcement office cases, debts and liens.
שלב 4 — שיחה עם בעל הדירה הקודם: Step 4: A conversation with the previous landlord
זו אחת הבדיקות הכי יעילות ולרוב הכי מוזנ: This is one of the most effective checks, and usually one of the most neglected. Ask for the previous landlord's phone number, not just their name, and speak to them directly. Ask: Did they pay on time? Did they look after the property? Did they leave on good terms?
מקובל בישראל לדרוש ערב אישי אחד או שניים: In Israel it's common to require one or two personal guarantors with proven income. The guarantor signs a separate agreement and undertakes to pay if the tenant doesn't. Under the Fair Rental Law, total guarantees may not exceed 3 months' rent (or one third of the total lease value).
שלב 6 — ביקור הדירה ותצפית: Step 6: The viewing and first impressions
שימו לב בביקור: האם הם מכבדים את הנכס? ש: Pay attention during the viewing: Do they treat the property with respect? Do they ask focused questions? Do they conduct themselves well? Sometimes the overall impression is more accurate than any paperwork.

חוק איסור אפליה במוצרים, שירותים וכניסה: The Prohibition of Discrimination in Products, Services and Entry into Public Places Law, 5752-1992, prohibits refusing to rent because of nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, personal status and more. שכירות לטווח קצר (STR) הפכה לאופציה פופו: Short-term rental (STR) has become a popular option in tourist cities such as Tel Aviv and Jerusalem, but the legal framework is very different from regular rentals. Ignorance of the law is no excuse.
המיסוי — ההבדל הקריטי מול שכירות רגילה: Taxation: the critical difference from regular rentals
רשות המסים בישראל מסווגת הכנסה מ-Airbnb: The Israel Tax Authority classifies Airbnb income as business income, not rent. This means the monthly exemption (₪5,654) does not apply to it at all.
כמה לילות בשנה, אקראי: A few nights a year, occasional
כן — חייב ברישום ודיווח שוטף: Yes: registration and regular reporting required

מה אומר ועד הבית?: What does the building committee say?
לפי חוק המקרקעין, תשכ\"ט-1969 ותקנון הבת: Under the Real Estate Law, 5729-1969, and the condominium bylaws, the building committee may prohibit "business activity" in the building. Israeli courts have ruled in a series of cases in favor of building committees that restricted Airbnb, including the Tel Aviv condominium tribunal, which held that renting for less than a month breaches the property's residential designation.
בדקו שהתקנון של הבניין אינו אוסר \"שימוש: Check that the building's bylaws don't prohibit "commercial use" or "short-term rentals". The building committee can obtain an injunction and leave you with high legal costs.
עיריית תל אביב-יפו ורשויות נוספות מחייבו: The Tel Aviv-Yafo Municipality and other local authorities require a business license for short-term rental activity run as a business. As of mid-2026, enforcement is limited but tightening, and running several properties without a license is a growing risk.
ביטוח דירה רגיל אינו מכסה נזקים שנגרמו ע: Regular home insurance does not cover damage caused by guests in a short-term rental, because insurers consider this activity "commercial". You should buy a dedicated STR policy or rely on Airbnb's Host Guarantee protection, and read the small print carefully.

דמי הניהול השוטפים נעים בישראל בין 8% ל-: In Israel, ongoing management fees range from 8% to 10% of the monthly rent (plus VAT) for a single property. Many companies also charge a minimum fee of ₪400–500 per month. In addition, there is usually a fee for finding a new tenant, typically 50%–100% of one month's rent.
ערך הזמן — מה אנשים שוכחים לחשב: The value of your time: what people forget to calculate
ניהול נכס מעסיק בממוצע 4-8 שעות בחודש בת: Managing a property takes an average of 4–8 hours a month during routine periods, and can reach 20–30 hours in a month when you change tenants. If your working hour is worth ₪100, those hours are worth ₪400–800 a month. And that's before you count the stress, being available at inconvenient hours, and personal responsibility for dealing with defects.

חברת ניהול טובה לא רק חוסכת זמן — היא מק: A good management company doesn't just save you time, it maximizes your returns. Higher occupancy, better tenants and quick repairs that prevent major damage are often worth more than the management fees themselves.
ביטוח הוא אחד הנושאים שבעלי דירות מטפלים: Insurance is one of those things landlords deal with less than they should, until something happens. The basic rule is that the owner insures the building and the tenant insures their belongings. In practice, though, it's more complicated.
סעיף 25ט לחוק שכירות הוגנת (2017) קובע מ: Section 25I of the Fair Rental Law (2017) states explicitly that the cost of building insurance is borne by the property owner alone. Any lease clause passing this cost on to the tenant is void by law.

שים לב: חלק מפוליסות המבנה אינן מכסות \": Note: some building policies do not cover "damage by a tenant", so it's important to ask for an explicit extension
